correctness.rationale: PASS: A cyclic word yields a balanced directed adjacency multigraph with connected nonisolated undirected support, and conversely an Euler tour realizes every such matrix. The three signed off-diagonal flow differences equal one d; when d is nonzero the oriented triangle guarantees connectedness, while d=0 has 0/1/2/3 positive bidirectional pairs. Five disjoint connected cases account for the rational generating function. Disconnected cases are exactly loop-only matrices with 2 or 3 active vertices or one bidirectional link plus a positive isolated loop. Independent SymPy cancellation of the submitted ordinary GF against the earlier bivariate GF at u=1 was identically zero. Coefficients 3,6,11,24,... are consistent; finite words and matrix scripts are corroboration, not infinite proof.
